entries.EN: So, what are you going to do now? No more fighting in the Arena, close your small business and search for a better life in distant lands, or what?
entries.JA_current: So, what are you going to do now? No more fighting in the Arena, close your small business and search for a better life in distant lands, or what?
entries.JA_new: それで、これからどうするんだ？ アリーナで戦うのはやめて、店も畳んで、遠い土地で新しい暮らしでも探すのか？

entries.EN: Don't be too quick with making decisions, Marked One. That was just one tournament out of many.
entries.JA_current: Don't be too quick with making decisions, Marked One. That was just one tournament out of many.
entries.JA_new: 焦って決めるなよ、マークドワン。大会なんて、まだいくつもあるんだからさ。

entries.EN: It may sound strange, but I suspected that from the very start. Come on, lay your cards on the table.
entries.JA_current: It may sound strange, but I suspected that from the very start. Come on, lay your cards on the table.
entries.JA_new: 意外かもしれないが、最初から気づいてたんだ。ほら、隠さず話してくれ。

entries.EN: So, you made it to the top and became the Champion of our Arena. Well, that's just a challenge title - nobody can be sure you aren't going to kick the bucket next time. The fights are held more or less regularly - once or twice a day, from 22:00 to 06:00. I'll be posting the arena fight times on the public network anyway so you'll get a heads up if you're interested. As long as you are the Champion, you are welcome to choose any of the announced fights. To put simply, it is up to you to decide who and what to fight with and when. But there are certain limitations about weapons and ammo: it is prohibited to use any kind of explosive ordnance, whether it's grenades or munitions, and especially not heavy weaponry. No grenade launchers, RPGs or those fancy Gauss-rifles, otherwise you're likely to demolish the whole compound and scare off competition, and we don't want that, right? That's it in a nutshell. Now, I have to get the cleaners to mop up the mess you made in there, so you are free to go to the Bar and get totally drunk. But don't be late for the opening! See you!

entries.JA_new: お前はアリーナの頂点に立って、チャンピオンになった。だが、あれは挑戦者につく称号にすぎない。次の試合で死なない保証はないからな。試合はだいたい定期的に、一日に1、2回、22:00から翌6:00まで行う。興味があるなら、試合の予定は公共ネットワークに載せておく。チャンピオンでいる間は、告知された試合ならどれでも選んでいい。誰と、何を使って、いつ戦うかはお前次第だ。ただし、武器と弾薬には制限がある。手榴弾や爆薬を含め、爆発物は一切禁止だ。重火器も使うな。グレネードランチャーもRPGも、あの大層なガウスライフルもだ。使えば施設を丸ごと吹き飛ばして、ほかの参加者まで逃げ出しちまう。それじゃ困るだろ？ まあ、ざっとこんなところだ。さて、お前が中で散らかした後始末を掃除屋に頼まなきゃならん。バーで浴びるほど飲んでくるといい。ただし、次の開幕に遅れるなよ。それじゃ！

entries.EN: Wow... Such enthusiasm... You'll have to wait - very few competitors yet. Come back later.
entries.JA_current: Wow... Such enthusiasm... You'll have to wait - very few competitors yet. Come back later.
entries.JA_new: その意気だな……と言いたいところだが、対戦相手がまだほとんどいなくてな。しばらく待ってくれ。あとでまた来てくれ。
正解だ！ おめでとう！

entries.EN: No luck... Maybe some other time.
entries.JA_current: No luck... Maybe some other time.
entries.JA_new: 今日はツキがないな……また今度にするか。

entries.EN: Wonderful fight! You've won the bounty and the bonus.
entries.JA_current: Wonderful fight! You've won the bounty and the bonus.
entries.JA_new: いい試合だった！ 賞金とボーナスはお前のものだ。
ルール違反によるペナルティだ。

entries.EN: Hi, Champ! You've decided to pay a visit to the Arena? I haven't had any noteworthy challengers for your title yet, but that doesn't mean you can't put on a show for us, help us bring in some cash! How about eliminating a couple of mutants? We've had a good number captured recently.
entries.JA_current: Hi, Champ! You've decided to pay a visit to the Arena? I haven't had any noteworthy challengers for your title yet, but that doesn't mean you can't put on a show for us, help us bring in some cash! How about eliminating a couple of mutants? We've had a good number captured recently.
entries.JA_new: よう、チャンプ！ アリーナに顔を出しに来たのか？ まだお前の座を脅かすような挑戦者はいないが、見せ場を作って客を呼び、ひと稼ぎすることはできる。捕獲したミュータントが何匹かいるんだ。そいつらを片付けてみないか？

entries.EN: Look, Marked One, I have a bit of a problem for you here. Hostile factions decided to temporarily put their differences aside to crush their common enemy.
entries.JA_current: Look, Marked One, I have a bit of a problem for you here. Hostile factions decided to temporarily put their differences aside to crush their common enemy.
entries.JA_new: なあ、マークドワン。ちょっと困ったことがあってな。敵対する勢力同士が一時休戦して、共通の敵を潰そうとしてるんだ。

entries.EN: How's that a problem for me?
entries.JA_current: How's that a problem for me?
entries.JA_new: それが俺に何の関係がある？

entries.EN: For you?.. Well, their "common enemy" is you. Just think about it, how many guys have you sent off to the heavens? Well, their pals who are still alive have began to refuse to fight alongside you... one at a time.
entries.JA_current: For you?.. Well, their "common enemy" is you. Just think about it, how many guys have you sent off to the heavens? Well, their pals who are still alive have began to refuse to fight alongside you... one at a time.
entries.JA_new: お前にとって、だよ……その「共通の敵」ってのがお前なんだ。考えてみろ。今まで何人をあの世に送った？ 生き残った連中の仲間が、お前と一緒に戦うのを嫌がり始めてる。一人、また一人とな。

entries.EN: Hello, Marked One. Look, we've had so many mutants delivered recently, that there's barely any room to keep them. Of-course, as ill luck would have it, no one's volunteered to fight them. How about you go for it?
entries.JA_current: Hello, Marked One. Look, we've had so many mutants delivered recently, that there's barely any room to keep them. Of-course, as ill luck would have it, no one's volunteered to fight them. How about you go for it?
entries.JA_new: やあ、マークドワン。最近ミュータントが次々運び込まれて、飼育場所がもう手狭でな。運の悪いことに、相手をしてくれる奴が誰もいない。お前、やってみないか？

entries.EN: Think it over, it would be a good deal. Earn a bit and help us out at the same time.
entries.JA_current: Think it over, it would be a good deal. Earn a bit and help us out at the same time.
entries.JA_new: よく考えてみろ。悪い話じゃないぞ。稼げるうえに、こっちも助かる。

entries.EN: Hi, Marked One. The Arena is open again. C'mon, choose the fight quickly. We have a tight schedule today.
entries.JA_current: Hi, Marked One. The Arena is open again. C'mon, choose the fight quickly. We have a tight schedule today.
entries.JA_new: よう、マークドワン。アリーナがまた開いたぞ。ほら、早く試合を選んでくれ。今日は予定が詰まってるんだ。

entries.EN: I have a request for you.
entries.JA_current: I have a request for you.

entries.EN: Include me in your notification list.
entries.JA_current: Include me in your notification list.
entries.JA_new: 俺にも通知を送ってくれ。
分かった。言うとおりにしよう。

entries.EN: Can you stop sending me your messages?
entries.JA_current: Can you stop sending me your messages?
entries.JA_new: もうメッセージを送らないでくれ。

entries.EN: Sure, I'll delete your PDA from the notification list.
entries.JA_current: Sure, I'll delete your PDA from the notification list.
entries.JA_new: 分かった。お前のPDAを通知リストから外しておく。

entries.EN: Can you turn on some more lights on the Arena?
entries.JA_current: Can you turn on some more lights on the Arena?
entries.JA_new: アリーナの照明をもう少し明るくしてくれないか？

entries.EN: I'll see what I can do.
entries.JA_current: I'll see what I can do.
entries.JA_new: できるかどうか見てみる。

entries.EN: Switch the lights back to normal.
entries.JA_current: Switch the lights back to normal.
entries.JA_new: 照明を元に戻してくれ。

entries.EN: Turn on... Switch off... Make a decision, man!
entries.JA_current: Turn on... Switch off... Make a decision, man!
entries.JA_new: 点ける……消す……どっちか決めてくれよ！

entries.review_notes: 短い選択肢でENだけでは対象が特定できない。会話グラフ上の選択肢として「MODを削除」と仮訳。

entries.EN: So, what fights are there today?
entries.JA_current: So, what fights are there today?
entries.JA_new: 今日はどんな試合がある？

entries.EN: None at the moment. Wait until opening.
entries.JA_current: None at the moment. Wait until opening.
entries.JA_new: 今はない。開場まで待ってくれ。

entries.EN: That's all for today - no more competitors.
entries.JA_current: That's all for today - no more competitors.
entries.JA_new: 今日はこれで終わりだ。もう対戦相手はいない。

entries.EN: If you are absolutely sure about your abilities, I can arrange fights with a time limit. These fights are usually very fast and require some real skills, but the money's better. Finish within the time allowed and you may get a bonus, sometimes I can even double the usual prize. But remember one strict rule: it is prohibited to kill your opponents after the timer has elapsed! The penalty for not following this rule is equal to the prize. I assure you, it's better to get no prize and remain with the money you have rather than having to dish out for the penalty. Besides, even if you fail, the survivors will get to live to fight another day, so more cash for us. So, what's your choice: should I set the timer?

entries.JA_new: 腕に相当自信があるなら、制限時間付きの試合を組める。短期決戦になるから、かなりの腕が要るが、そのぶん報酬もいい。制限時間内に勝てばボーナスが付くし、いつもの倍出せることもある。ただし、絶対に守ってもらうルールが一つある。時間切れになったら、相手を殺すな。破った場合のペナルティは賞金と同額だ。ペナルティを払うくらいなら、賞金なしで今の手持ちを守ったほうがましだぞ。それに、負けても生き残った相手は次の試合に出られる。こっちにとっても、そのほうが稼ぎになる。どうする？ 制限時間を設定するか？
誰にも賭けない。やめておく。

entries.EN: Some other time maybe - my wallet is empty.
entries.JA_current: Some other time maybe - my wallet is empty.
entries.JA_new: また今度だ。財布が空っぽでな。

entries.EN: Bets have been made - all bets are off.
entries.JA_current: Bets have been made - all bets are off.
entries.JA_new: 賭けは成立だ。これで締め切りだ。

entries.EN: Wanna make some money without risking your health? You have come to the right place! You are welcome to bet in two ways: Mutant Fighting and Factions' Tournament. It's simple: you tell me who you want to bet on, pay the cash and tramp to the stand to watch the fight. If you win - you get your money and a bonus, if you lose... Well, at least you'll get some quality entertainment from a good fight. So, what's your bet?
